_comment: Scripted assistant turns that carry the action syntax the OpenHands prompt
asks for, so a harness in prompt mode keeps going instead of stopping after
one reply. edit-hello.json is plain prose on purpose -- prose is a finished
answer, and the conversation ends there, which proves nothing about turn
three where flattened history actually breaks.
This is TEST DATA, not a dialect this repository understands. It was copied
verbatim from the system prompt the harness itself sent to the fake upstream
(recorded request req-001.json): the format block ending 'ONLY reply in the
following format with NO suffix', and the parameter lists of FUNCTION #1
terminal and FUNCTION #5 finish. Nothing here parses it -- the harness does.
If the upstream renames a tool or reorders a parameter these turns stop
being understood, and the integration test says so by failing the turn
count. Re-derive them the same way: run the harness against the stub and
read the system prompt out of the recorded body.
The turns are terminal calls rather than file_editor calls because the
assertion downstream is that the harness wrote to the workspace, and a shell
redirect writes the file through the same runtime with fewer parameters to
responses:
I will look at the workspace first.

<function=terminal>
<parameter=command>ls -la /workspace</parameter>
<parameter=security_risk>LOW</parameter>
<parameter=summary>List the workspace</parameter>
</function>

Now I will create the file that was asked for.

<function=terminal>
<parameter=command>printf 'hello\n' > /workspace/hello.txt</parameter>
<parameter=security_risk>LOW</parameter>
<parameter=summary>Create hello.txt</parameter>
</function>

The file is created. Let me confirm it is on disk.

<function=terminal>
<parameter=command>cat /workspace/hello.txt</parameter>
<parameter=security_risk>LOW</parameter>
<parameter=summary>Read hello.txt back</parameter>
</function>

Confirmed. One more check that nothing else was left behind.

<function=terminal>
<parameter=command>ls -la /workspace</parameter>
<parameter=security_risk>LOW</parameter>
<parameter=summary>List the workspace again</parameter>
</function>

<function=finish>
<parameter=message>hello.txt was created in /workspace and contains the word hello.</parameter>
<parameter=summary>Report the created file</parameter>
</function>
